groups.schedules-jobs.title: Cards of limits on the General settings page. Socios are AI agents; a Space is a product noun (a shared area for a team).
groups.data-space.title: Heading of a limits card: how much each person may store in datasets (tables of data) and files.
groups.shared-areas.title: Heading of a limits card: what a company socio (an AI agent the whole company shares) keeps for everyone who uses it.
groups.plugin-datasets.title: Heading of a limits card: datasets (tables of data) that plugins own and fill.
groups.analytical-tables.title: Heading of a limits card: compressed history tables plugins keep for reports and analysis.
groups.dot-turns.title: Heading of a limits card: how much work a socio (AI agent) may do for one reply.
groups.memory.title: Heading of a limits card: how long socios (AI agents) keep what they remember of people’s chats, and each Space’s shared memory.
groups.rooms.title: Heading of a limits card: the most one message, and the work it starts, may use in any chat.
groups.continuous-copy.title: Heading of a limits card: when admins are alerted that the continuous copy (Litestream’s copy of the database) is falling behind.
groups.plugin-backups.title: Heading of a limits card: how much of each plugin’s own storage is backed up.
limits.scheduleMinIntervalMinutes.label: Each limit: label (the field's label), unit (shown after the number field, plural, such as "minutes" or "MB") and help (the line under it). MB, GiB and USD are unit symbols.
limits.scheduleMinIntervalMinutes.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Shortest gap between runs", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.schedulesPerUser.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: how many active schedules (recurring tasks) one person’s socios (AI agents) may have.
limits.schedulesPerUser.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Active schedules per person", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.jobMaxTimeoutSeconds.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: the most time one background job may ask for.
limits.jobMaxTimeoutSeconds.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Longest job timeout", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.jobConcurrency.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: how many background jobs may run at the same time in the workspace.
limits.jobConcurrency.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Jobs running at once", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.jobsPerUser.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: how many saved background jobs one person’s socios (AI agents) may keep.
limits.jobsPerUser.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Saved jobs per person", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.jobItemAttempts.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: how many times a job tries one item before it marks it failed.
limits.jobItemAttempts.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Tries per item", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.jobBatchRetries.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: how many failed batches in a row stop a job.
limits.jobBatchRetries.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Retries in a row", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.jobMaxBatches.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: the most batches one run of a job may take.
limits.jobMaxBatches.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Batches per run", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataFileMaxMb.label: Field label on the "Data space" limits card, followed by a number field: the size of the largest file allowed.
limits.dataFileMaxMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Largest file", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.dataDatasetMaxMb.label: Field label on the "Data space" limits card, followed by a number field: the size one dataset (table of data) may grow to.
limits.dataDatasetMaxMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Largest dataset", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.dataUserMaxMb.label: Field label on the "Data space" limits card, followed by a number field: how much data each person may store in total.
limits.dataUserMaxMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Data per person", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.dataMaxDatasets.label: Field label on the "Data space" limits card, followed by a number field: how many datasets (tables of data) one person may have.
limits.dataMaxDatasets.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Datasets per person", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataSharedRetentionDays.label: Field label on the "Socios’ shared areas" limits card, followed by a number field: how long unchanged items in a company socio’s shared area are kept.
limits.dataSharedRetentionDays.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Keep shared items for", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataStampTombstoneDays.label: Field label on the "Data space" limits card, followed by a number field: how long the server remembers deleted dataset rows, for apps that keep an offline copy.
limits.dataStampTombstoneDays.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Remember deleted rows for", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataPluginDatasetMaxMb.label: Field label on the "Plugin datasets" limits card, followed by a number field: the size one dataset owned by a plugin may grow to.
limits.dataPluginDatasetMaxMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Largest plugin dataset", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.dataPluginQueryMaxRows.label: Field label on the "Plugin datasets" limits card, followed by a number field: the most rows one query of a plugin’s dataset returns.
limits.dataPluginQueryMaxRows.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Rows per query of a plugin dataset", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataPluginStatementsPerMinute.lab: Field label on the "Plugin datasets" limits card, followed by a number field: how many data operations one plugin may make each minute.
limits.dataPluginStatementsPerMinute.uni: Unit shown after the number field of "Data operations a minute per plugin", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataAnalyticalMaxMb.label: Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: how much the analytical tables of one owner (a person, a socio’s shared area or a plugin) may hold.
limits.dataAnalyticalMaxMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Analytical data per owner", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: the most time one analytical query may run.
Unit shown after the number field of "Longest analytical query", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataAnalyticsQueryMaxRows.label: Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: the most rows one analytical query returns.
limits.dataAnalyticsQueryMaxRows.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Rows per analytical query", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataAppendMaxRows.label: Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: the most rows one addition to an analytical table may take.
limits.dataAppendMaxRows.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Rows per append", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataAnalyticsQueryMemoryMb.label: Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: how much memory one analytical query may use.
limits.dataAnalyticsQueryMemoryMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Memory per analytical query", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.dataAnalyticsQueryConcurrency.lab: Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: how many analytical queries may run at the same time.
limits.dataAnalyticsQueryConcurrency.uni: Unit shown after the number field of "Analytical queries at once", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dataAnalyticsRetainDays.label: Field label on the "Analytical tables" limits card, followed by a number field: how long older parts (partitions) of analytical tables are kept.
limits.dataAnalyticsRetainDays.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Keep analytical partitions for", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.dotModelRounds.label: Field label on the "Socio replies" limits card, followed by a number field: how many times a socio (AI agent) may call its AI model in one reply; a turn is one reply.
limits.dotModelRounds.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Model rounds per turn", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.turnTimeLimitSeconds.label: Field label on the "Socio replies" limits card, followed by a number field: how long one reply of a socio (AI agent) may run; a turn is one reply.
limits.turnTimeLimitSeconds.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Turn time limit", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.turnRecallTokens.label: Field label on the "Socio replies" limits card, followed by a number field: how much of a person’s memories goes with each message, in tokens (units of text an AI model counts).
limits.turnRecallTokens.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Recalled context per reply", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.episodeRetentionDays.label: Field label on the "Memory" limits card, followed by a number field: how long socios (AI agents) keep episodes, what they remember of each earlier chat.
limits.episodeRetentionDays.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Keep episodes for", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.spaceMemoryRetentionDays.label: Field label on the "Memory" limits card, followed by a number field: how long retired entries and older versions of a Space’s shared memory are kept.
limits.spaceMemoryRetentionDays.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Keep retired Space memory for", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.steeringMaxQueued.label: Field label on the "Socio replies" limits card, followed by a number field: how many messages one person may queue in a chat while the socio (AI agent) works.
limits.steeringMaxQueued.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Queued messages per chat", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.roomCycleTokens.label: Field label on the "Work per message" limits card, followed by a number field: the most AI model tokens (units of text a model counts) one message and its work may use.
limits.roomCycleTokens.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Tokens per message", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.roomMessagesPerMinute.label: Field label on the "Work per message" limits card, followed by a number field: how many messages a chat takes each minute, from everyone in it.
limits.roomMessagesPerMinute.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Messages a minute per chat", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.roomHandoffsPerCycle.label: Field label on the "Work per message" limits card, followed by a number field: how many times one message’s work may pass from one socio (AI agent) to another.
limits.roomHandoffsPerCycle.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Handoffs per message", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.roomCycleSpendUsd.label: Field label on the "Work per message" limits card, followed by a number field: the most one message’s AI model use may cost, in US dollars.
limits.roomCycleSpendUsd.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Spend per message", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.copyLagWarnMinutes.label: The continuous copy (Litestream's copy of the database) is behind the newest write.
limits.copyLagWarnMinutes.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Copy behind: warning", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.copyLagCriticalMinutes.label: Field label on the "Continuous copy alerts" limits card, followed by a number field: how far behind the continuous copy (Litestream’s copy of the database) is before the alert turns critical.
limits.copyLagCriticalMinutes.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Copy behind: critical", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.walWarnMb.label: The write-ahead log (WAL) is SQLite's log of changes not yet written to the database file.
limits.walWarnMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Write-ahead log: warning", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.walCriticalMb.label: Field label on the "Continuous copy alerts" limits card, followed by a number field: the size of the write-ahead log (SQLite’s log of changes not yet written to the database file) at which the alert turns critical.
limits.walCriticalMb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Write-ahead log: critical", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
limits.pluginBackupMaxGb.label: Field label on the "Plugin backups" limits card, followed by a number field: the most one plugin’s backup snapshot may hold.
limits.pluginBackupMaxGb.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Largest snapshot per plugin", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. A unit symbol: keep it, or use your language’s usual symbol.
saved: Toast: {{title}} is the card's title from groups.
reset: Toast: {{title}} is the card's title from groups.
invalid: Error: {{label}} is the field's label, {{min}} and {{max}} its range, {{units}} its unit.
startsAt: Follows a limit's help: the value the server uses when nobody changed it here.
useDefaults: Button on each limits card: puts every limit on that card back to the value the server starts with.
